surfaces.title: Catalog Service Plugin
surfaces.reason: Service plugin (SPI), and here the 'not relevant' verdict is genuinely right for a reason worth stating: a catalog provider plugin makes an EXTERNAL catalog sellable on Wix, which is the OPPOSITE of migrating -- it keeps the data at the source. Never a migration path. See domains/SERVICE-PLUGINS.md for the escalation rule, the cost list, a worked example and the full 25-plugin catalog.

surfaces.title: Inventory Service Plugin

surfaces.title: Discounts
surfaces.reason: Service plugin (SPI), so not an import path -- BUT NOT IRRELEVANT, and this entry was previously wrong to imply otherwise. The Custom Discount Triggers plugin CLOSED A REAL MAPPING GAP on 2026-08-31: a WooCommerce bulk/tiered discount needs mutually exclusive quantity BANDS, Wix's native bounded ITEM_QUANTITY_RANGE leaves the rule unrenderable in the merchant dashboard, and open-ended ranges stack (21 items matched all five tiers -> 75% off instead of 25%). A custom trigger answers yes/no per cart, so the band is exact. Implemented and deployed; see the bounded-quantity-bands-need-a-custom-trigger-spi pitfall on entities/discount-rule.json. See domains/SERVICE-PLUGINS.md for the escalation rule, the cost list, a worked example and the full 25-plugin catalog.

surfaces.title: Shipping Rates
surfaces.reason: Service plugin (SPI) -- not an import path, but a CANDIDATE GAP-CLOSER rather than noise. This is the natural home for a source shipping rate table Wix's own shipping options cannot express; a free-shipping-over-threshold condition and per-shipping-class costs are both known to fail natively. Not yet attempted. See domains/SERVICE-PLUGINS.md for the escalation rule, the cost list, a worked example and the full 25-plugin catalog.

surfaces.title: Order Billing
surfaces.reason: Billing details are carried on the imported order payload, but refund records use the separate Refund Payments surface (POST /ecom/v1/order-billing/refund-payments). Live verification established that externalRefund:true is mandatory for historical data.

surfaces.title: Order Transactions
surfaces.reason: Add Payments is the first half of the refund write path: Import Order creates no payment record, so a payment must be added before Order Billing's Refund Payments has a paymentId to reference. Note this surface alone is payments-only (refunds reach it as the Refund Completed webhook, and balanceSummary.refunded is computed) — the refund create lives in the sibling Order Billing tree, and reading this menu in isolation produced a false 'no refund-record import path' conclusion on 2026-08-12, corrected 2026-08-16.
